# Vendored third-party code

## js-aruco2
- Source: https://github.com/damianofalcioni/js-aruco2
- Files: `cv.js`, `aruco.js`, `apriltag_16h5.js`
- License: MIT (Copyright (c) 2020 Damiano Falcioni / Copyright (c) 2011 Juan Mellado).
  The full license text is embedded in the header of `cv.js` and `aruco.js`.

## AprilTag 16h5 dictionary
- `apriltag_16h5.js` contains the tag16h5 code list extracted from
  https://github.com/AprilRobotics/apriltag-generation (Tag16h5.java)
- License: BSD 2-Clause (Copyright (C) 2013-2016, The Regents of The University of Michigan).
  The full license text is embedded in the header of `apriltag_16h5.js`.

These files are served locally on purpose: when the phone joins the PC's hotspot
it usually has no internet access, so no CDN may be used.
